description:
This is a Pre-Solicitation Notice for the procurement of Aveva Software Licenses and customer support IAW the Item Description. FOB destination is Tinker AFB, OK. This requirement is a sole source acquisition to Q-Mation, LLC.

No quotes can be accepted until the solicitation has been posted. 

Please send in the actual solicitation completed along with any other documentation to support your company’s quote.

Please make sure information stated is readable and legible.

This is a Firm Fixed Price procurement, so please state the price on your quote as all inclusive of everything. ( i.e. shipping, taxes, fees, etc.)

POC: MADELYN.WIENS@US.AF.MIL
